m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Greetings! I trust the day is as kind to you as you have been to the folk of Avalon.
What's that? A Sacred Word? Odd... I was just thinking about the one that I found recently. You're welcome to it!
<ITALICS>He whispers a word to you, too powerful to say aloud. It sounds a bit like "knee"... you think, though it hurts you to hear it. </ITALICS>
You have recovered the three Sacred Words as I asked. I cannot fault you that. But... there is one small problem!
I am no longer the Knight of the Sacred Words... I am the Knight Who Says Ecce Ecce Ecce P'Kang Ruim-Boing! Fear me!
... not even a little? All right then, never mind. Please move along.
I am the Keeper of the Sacred Words... but I cannot remember what they were!
I beg you... help me recover the three Sacred Words that were lost, and restore me to my former greatness.
The first of the Sacred Words can be had from Francis Lux, in the Standing Tower in Abbey Road.
The second Sacred Word is in a Moldering Book stored in the Archive. You will know it when you see it!
In the Forlorn Tower you will find the third and yet greatest of the Sacred Words, but you must first defeat its guardian!
I await your return. Do not forget the three Sacred Words... as I have!
Gather the three lost Sacred Words from Francis Lux in Abbey Road, the Moldering Book in the Archive, and the Forlorn Tower.
